headline: Jocil Limited releases September 2026 quarterly and half-year results
summary: Jocil Limited has officially filed its financial results for the quarter and half-year ending September 2026. why_it_matters: Review earnings to assess company valuation and dividend potential.

headline: John Cockerill India receives Reserve Bank of India approval for a €24.32 million share swap
hook: RBI nod clears cross-border share swap
summary: John Cockerill India has secured approval from the Reserve Bank of India to execute a share swap valued at €24.32 million. The transaction involves equity restructuring and cross-border capital movement for the engineering firm. Retail investors can view this regulatory clearance as a key step in the company's corporate restructuring plans. The approval eliminates a major procedural hurdle for the execution of the agreed share exchange.
why_it_matters: Regulatory clearance unlocks John Cockerill's pending share swap plan.
winners_losers: John Cockerill India gains / no clear losers

headline: John Cockerill India gets RBI nod to acquire subsidiary
summary: John Cockerill India has received approval from the Reserve Bank of India to acquire a subsidiary. The regulatory clearance paves the way for the company to proceed with the transaction. Further financial details and timelines of the acquisition have not been disclosed in the initial filing. Indian retail investors should note this corporate development as it may impact the company's operational structure and future growth strategy.
whats_next: Company announcement on transaction completion and timelines
why_it_matters: Subsidiary integration could alter corporate structure and earnings.
winners_losers: John Cockerill India gains / none hurt
